title: Priorities share the review's shapes
text: A card's priority no longer shows a flag. It now uses the same shape as the matching code-review severity: a dashed ring with a dot for trivial, a circle for low, a square for medium, a diamond for high, a double diamond for very high, and a double diamond with an exclamation mark for critical. Colours are unchanged, so you can tell a priority by its shape as well as its colour.
